name: ce-plugin
description: Public gold set built from the Compound Engineering plugin's own learnings under docs/solutions/. Each positive case is a work context phrased the way a skill would phrase it, never the learning's title, with the learning (or learnings) a person doing that work should have read. Labels are positive-only: a hit that is not listed is unjudged, not wrong. Negative cases describe work the corpus does not cover and expect nothing_relevant.
